segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: "I'm pleased about the grey one." He went on down. "I'd thought being envied would feel like the top of the ladder. It feels like Gower eating a pasty and counting." He was quiet for three steps. "Give me the foot of the ladder, and you saying set."
segments.instruct: Warm, restrained Australian narration. Dry, thoughtful dialogue; preserve contracted tense clearly. Quiet narrator for actions and attribution.

segments.text: "I'll not hold back because you've told me. I'd not want it thought I let you off."
segments.instruct: Warm, restrained Australian narration. Firm but unshowy reply; preserve the contracted tense and full thought clearly. Stay in the same adult narrator voice.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: "I wrote that down. I write everything down." The Reader shut the satchel. "Tomorrow they'll read it aloud in a dock. All of it. Yours and hers and the keepers'." She looked at Kiva for a long moment. "I've kept that page in the dark for nine months so that it could be believed. I'd like you to know I've never once been curious what's on it. I'll be curious tomorrow."
segments.instruct: Warm, restrained Australian narration. Clear factual recollection; distinguish the changing tenses and keep attribution precise. Return to the base narrator for actions and attribution.
